electrical.normal_operating_condition_v: 4.5 to 5.5 V in datasheet electrical-characteristics table
electrical.logic_high_requirement: DIN high >= 3.4 V at VDD=5.0 V

pcb_assumptions.board_style: 24 mm round carrier matching the existing LED/lamp carrier family
pcb_assumptions.mounting: four M2 NPTH holes on 12 x 12 mm pattern
pcb_assumptions.connector: two side 1x02 2.54 mm headers with KiCad-model-aligned holes: left J1 top-to-bottom is DOUT/+5V, right J2 top-to-bottom is GND/DIN
pcb_assumptions.din_series_resistor: not fitted; direct DIN route for a compact single-LED carrier. Add external 220-470 ohm series resistance if the controller lead is long or noisy.
pcb_assumptions.decoupling: 0.1 uF 0603 capacitor on B.Cu, connected from the back side through the side header pads so top-side routing remains visually one trace per LED foot
pcb_assumptions.visible_top_routing: four F.Cu traces only: LED foot 1 VDD, foot 2 DOUT, foot 3 GND, foot 4 DIN
pcb_assumptions.soldering: manual soldering or JLC SMT if the exact SK6812RGBW reel and orientation are matched later
